children: has changed the name of Lake Ontario to "Lake America" on the web version of its Apple Maps following U.S. President Donald Trump's executive order renaming the lake.
The move by Apple on Tuesday followed a decision by Alphabet
late on Saturday to change the name of the lake on its Google Maps for U.S. users.
